author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Inspected 48px and 384px in light and dark: a tall rounded C with ends curling back, crossed by a 45-degree slash from outside the lower left to a free end inside the bowl; reads as the colon sign like the reference. The rejected drawing ran the slash into the C's top end. A first slash was too short and high and was lengthened.
omissions: The slash is at 45 degrees (the reference is slightly steeper) so the crossing lands on an exact integer node.
drawing_plan: VRECT_L; C: bezier bows with extremes (24,4)/(24,44), ends (40,8)/(40,40), straight side x 12 (18..30) split at (12,28); slash (8,32)-(12,28)-(26,14).
lucide_reference: Lucide 'cent'/'euro': currency letter with a crossing stroke.
